Metadata.Goal: 让 Eidolon workflow contract、XNL loader/validator 与 deterministic drafts 直接复用 depa-flows authority。
Metadata.Description: 移除平行核心语义，保留 Eidolon-owned facts 和 surface projections。

TaskSpace.name: bind-eidolon-ai-workflow-to-depa-flows-core
TaskSpace.Description: Canonical depa-flows contracts and XNL loading in the Eidolon workflow component.

TaskGroup.name: Canonical contract binding
TaskGroup.Description: Replace duplicated core vocabulary with canonical imports while preserving additive Eidolon facts.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Contract tests prove canonical descriptors, policies and refs
Eidolon data-subgraph authority tests remain green

Task.name: Add canonical dependencies and contract adapter
Task.Description: Add published depa-flows packages and replace local kinds/ref policy types with imports or compatibility aliases.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: depa-flows workflow descriptors, reuse defaults and definition binding types are exported through the cell contract
Eidolon data-subgraph ownership and runtime-ref projections remain additive and tested

Task.name: Route resource-ref validation through canonical logic
Task.Description: Preserve the existing JSON validation projection while delegating acceptance to depa-flows parsing.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Allowed refs are accepted with canonical schemes
Unsafe and unregistered refs are rejected by canonical parsing

TaskGroup.name: Canonical resource loading and draft proof
TaskGroup.Description: Add the source-only loader facade and make deterministic scaffolds round-trip through it.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Both canonical forms return typed bindings and structured diagnostics

Task.name: Add WorkflowResourceLoader canonical facade
Task.Description: Dispatch named XNL sources to canonical AICtrlWorkflow/AIDataWorkflow loaders and normalize results for the component.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Valid sources for both forms return the expected typed canonical binding
Invalid root/node/statement diagnostics retain source or node context and no binding is returned

Task.name: Make deterministic bundle drafts canonical-loadable
Task.Description: Update scaffolds and command evidence so both forms are loaded and proven before the draft is returned.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: AI ctrl and AI data drafts each contain a canonical profile manifest
Both draft manifests round-trip through WorkflowResourceLoader with no diagnostics

TaskGroup.name: Compatibility verification
TaskGroup.Description: Run affected tests/typechecks and prove no local core parser remains.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: Affected package tests and typecheck pass
Dependency and source scans show canonical authority

Task.name: Run core binding verification
Task.Description: Run contract/component/tool tests, typecheck and authority scans; record evidence for mission CORE.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: No Eidolon-private workflow XNL parser or substrate implementation is introduced
